findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stocks_list, dilution_check · Private data: stocks_list, stock_quote, token_quote, swap_quote, token_risk, swap_build, wallet_setup, wallet_holdings, wallet_flows, wallet_events, watch_wallet, unwatch_wallet, watched_wallets, watched_events, token_report, token_holders, bundle_check, dev_check, company_financials, filing_text, filing_search, agent_lookup, check_seller · Public sink: swap_build, token_holders, bundle_check, company_financials, fund_holdings, dilution_check · Destructive: wallet_holdings, unwatch_wallet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stocks_list, dilution_check · Private data: stocks_list, stock_quote, token_quote, swap_quote, token_risk, swap_build, wallet_setup, wallet_holdings, wallet_flows, wallet_events, watch_wallet, unwatch_wallet, watched_wallets, watched_events, token_report, token_holders, bundle_check, dev_check, company_financials, filing_text, filing_search, agent_lookup, check_seller · Public sink: swap_build, token_holders, bundle_check, company_financials, fund_holdings, dilution_check · Destructive: wallet_holdings, unwatch_wallet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
